_readme: Copy this file to  contact.json  in the same folder and fill it in.
contact.json is gitignored, so it never reaches GitHub (your repo is public).
Any field left empty is simply not rendered - no broken icon, no empty link.
Delete a line entirely and it disappears too.
ON RENDER: contact.json is not in git, so it will not be deployed. Instead paste
the whole JSON as an environment variable named CONTACT_JSON (Render dashboard ->
Environment -> Add Environment Variable). The server prefers the env var and falls
back to the file, so local dev uses the file and production uses the variable, and
your details sit in neither git nor this conversation.
